run_download_samples: run the script to download the yashkant/pippo dataset from Hugging Face Hub
run_snapshot_download: run snapshot_download to fetch a Hugging Face dataset to a local directory
review_snapshot_download: review the snapshot_download call that downloads the pippo dataset without symlinks
